visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short haircut wearing a black t-shirt and a dark blue cap stands in front of a beige-paneled wall. He holds three stacked yellow boxes labeled 'Glad Press'n Seal' with both hands. His facial expressions are animated and enthusiastic as he speaks, gesturing towards the product boxes while explaining the contents. (2) The scene shifts to show a young girl in a blue printed t-shirt pulling a long, translucent sheet of plastic wrap across a tiled living room floor. A woman is partially visible in the background, sitting on a light-colored sofa using her mobile phone in the well-lit room. The camera tracks the plastic extension. (3) The man and the girl are now kneeling on the floor. The man is holding a plastic tray filled with raw red meat strips. He begins placing the meat pieces individually onto the laid-out plastic wrap in a long line on the light-colored tiled floor. The environment is a clean, modern domestic living space. (4) A second layer of the wrap is folded over the meat. Both the man and the girl use their hands to press firmly around each piece of meat, removing all air. The girl then uses silver scissors to cut the sealed segments into individual packets while the man continues the pressing process. (5) The man is back in a kneeling position, holding a large bundle of individually sealed meat packets towards the camera. He looks directly at the lens with a satisfied expression and gives a thumbs-up. The background shows the same living room area with various furniture and home decor items.
